Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows Mg, Sc, and Zn centers each in close-packed-like local arrangements with 12 geometric neighbors, with Sc and Zn environments containing Sc, Mg, and Zn neighbors. The neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 18 sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis identifies Sc–Sc 12-vertex polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
